verdict.rationale: incident.io's postmortem AI docs say it generates first drafts of postmortems, offers inline review suggestions, and redrafts sections with AI, which supports a human-reviewed draft. Separately, the product auto-generates a key-event timeline and AI Suggestions drafts follow-up actions from incident activity. The evidence does not show the postmortem draft itself covering timeline, contributing factors and follow-ups. Missing for 10: evidence that the AI draft includes contributing factors, evidence that the draft pulls in the timeline and follow-ups from the incident record, and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts the postmortem from the incident record — timeline, contributing factors, follow-ups — ready for human review

citations.quote: Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.
We generate a simple timeline based on key events
automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity
